decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby approved shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (26_1100 (Rev A), 26_2100 (Rev A) 26_2600 (Rev A), received 26/03/2014) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby approved shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of rear roof extension with additional roof light to front elevation and a single storey rear extension to the house.
